deferred_to_upstream.summary: Generator support for secondary credentials: config schema and auth command group should model every credential the spec declares, not just the primary one.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Same gap as cli-printing-press#2913 cascade item 2 — generated auth status/set-token only know the primary token. Any printed CLI whose API needs a second key hits it; the local patch supersedes once the generator emits a per-credential config slot.
